Priya: quick sync request 1 min. proposing a "golden-run" + small capability probe for model ingest to reduce runtime surprises.
Owen: curious: golden-run = tiny deterministic bench?
Priya: yep. seeded prompts, fixed RNG, run on a reference host, output golden tokens + compact perf trace.
Marta: how do we prevent teams from gaming seeds?
Priya: bench-team maintains canonical seedsets per model family. registry requires at least one long and one multi-turn seed.
Samir: capability probe idea: run <30s checks for fused_attention, kv layout variants, and aten ops presence; annotate registry with compatibility_status.
Ken: what outcomes do we have? compatible / partial / incompatible? and enforcement?
Priya: three levels. default: warn for hosted, block promotion to dedicated/private when major bench_suite_version mismatch or incompatible.
Owen: comparator: strict equality is too noisy. use token-id diff + perf thresholds.
Marta: propose defaults: token-id-levenshtein <=3% => ok, p50 within 10% => ok. expose flags to tune.
Samir: add bench_suite_version and bench_host_tag in golden blob. also bench_config_checksum and max_wall_time.
Priya: agreed. ingestion CI runs golden + probe and writes bench_signature. archive results in registry.
InfraBot: CI note: new presubmit job `golden-probe` created (job 121478), runtime ~60s on reference image.
Ken: migration: run golden-probe on existing models and annotate, but do not block traffic.
Owen: action items: Priya PR for guideline + sample manifest, Samir prototype probe, Owen comparator lib.
Priya: will open RFC with examples + tiny reference runner. closing thread once RFC posted. :pray:
